tickets.title: Document current system, target, evidence and next dependencies
gate_cmd:
import json
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('docs/roadmap/system.json')
d=json.loads(p.read_text())
assert d['schema_version']==1 and d['baseline_commit']=='eb2d4c57d409458d09bf27d4a70ebb067e8e7a8f'
assert d['executable'] is False and d['paid_runs_authorized'] is False
for key in ('current_components','data_assets','decisions','work_items'):
 assert isinstance(d[key],list) and d[key]
items=d['decisions']+d['work_items']
ids=[x['id'] for x in items]
assert len(ids)==len(set(ids))
known=set(ids)
remaining={}
for x in items:
 assert x['status'] in ('ready_for_design','blocked','future')
 assert x['owner'] and x['deliverable'] and x['acceptance']
 assert isinstance(x['depends_on'],list) and set(x['depends_on'])<=known and x['id'] not in x['depends_on']
 remaining[x['id']]=set(x['depends_on'])
while remaining:
 ready={key for key,value in remaining.items() if not value}
 assert ready,'Dependency cycle'
 remaining={key:value-ready for key,value in remaining.items() if key not in ready}
for component in d['current_components']:
 assert component['status'] in ('implemented_offline','mock_or_injected','historical_source','not_implemented')
 for path in component['evidence_paths']:assert Path(path).is_file(),path
for asset in d['data_assets']:
 assert asset['availability'] in ('tracked','catalog_only','fixture_only','missing_or_unverified')
 for path in asset['evidence_paths']:assert Path(path).is_file(),path
text=Path('SYSTEM_ROADMAP.md').read_text()
for heading in ('What exists now','What we are building toward','Data and evidence available','Decisions before implementation','Dependency order','Next work','Acceptance gates','Limits'):
 assert '## '+heading in text,heading
for id in ids:assert id in text,id
assert len(text)>12000
for path in ('README.md','AGENTS.md','STATUS_AND_ARCHITECTURE.md'):
 assert 'SYSTEM_ROADMAP.md' in Path(path).read_text()
print('PASS roadmap structure, dependency DAG, evidence paths and navigation')
